roomFinishes.chrome-room: Low-saturation silver. Sparse lost gloss around side bends and floor glides. Never orange full-frame rust.
roomFinishes.sofa-leather: Deep brown contiguous large surfaces, very subtle seat-front touch wear and cushion folds. No checkerboard noise or stitched grids.
roomFinishes.sofa-cloth: Muted grey green; fold shade near contact seams, mostly intact planes.
roomFinishes.wardrobe-oak: Warm restrained grain follows actual board axis, 1–2 low-contrast short strokes; drawer/door front handling may fade at edges.
roomFinishes.blanket-sage: Fold shading concentrated at fold/front edge, pillow kept plain.
